# Arcsmith

> Arcsmith builds Uniswap v4 hooks from reviewed blocks on Arc (Circle's USDC-gas L1), and reads what any Uniswap v4 hook on Arc mainnet can do before you trade through it. Answers are capabilities, not verdicts: what a hook's address allows, not what it does or whether it is safe.

## For AI agents
- [MCP server](https://arcsmith.xyz/mcp): remote MCP (Streamable HTTP, stateless, read-only, no key). Tools: check_hook, check_token, trade_cost, pre_trade_check, top_hooks.
- [Hook check API](https://arcsmith.xyz/docs/api): the same answers as JSON over HTTP, free, no key, 60 requests a minute per IP.
  - GET https://arcsmith.xyz/api/v1/hooks/{address}
  - GET https://arcsmith.xyz/api/v1/tokens/{address}?cost=true
  - GET https://arcsmith.xyz/api/v1/pools/{poolId}/cost
  - GET https://arcsmith.xyz/api/v1/rankings

## Docs
- [Introduction](https://arcsmith.xyz/docs): what Arcsmith is and who it is for
- [How it works](https://arcsmith.xyz/docs/how-it-works): one kernel hook, small blocks, rules frozen per pool
- [Reading any hook](https://arcsmith.xyz/docs/hook-reader): the seven questions the Hook Reader answers
- [Safety guarantees](https://arcsmith.xyz/docs/safety): what the kernel enforces whatever the blocks do
- [Contract addresses](https://arcsmith.xyz/docs/contracts): every contract on Arc mainnet, verified on Arc Explorer
- [Risks](https://arcsmith.xyz/docs/risks): unaudited software; what can go wrong

## Source
- [GitHub](https://github.com/arcsmithxyz/arcsmith): contracts, verification inputs and the web app (MIT)
